scenario.name: r-cw-6-max-chain-length
scenario.description: The max-chain boundary uses a disposable exact-candidate runtime fixture; continue_work is intentionally not externally invocable through the gateway loopback.
scenario.registryNotes: The legacy k6 entry remains fail-closed because it cannot invoke continue_work through WebSocket/MCP and must not mutate shared config. Use run-max-chain-fixture.mjs; see docs/R-CW-6-ISOLATED-MAX-CHAIN.md.

invocation.fixtureState: temporary session store seeded at maxChainLength-2; two valid elections advance to the limit and the first over-limit election is rejected

expectedReceipts.name: fixture-readiness
expectedReceipts.description: Exact source/SHA, installed dependencies, explicit maxChainLength, and zero production mutation are proven before execution.

expectedReceipts.name: boundary-matrix
expectedReceipts.description: The production budget predicate permits attempted hops max-1 and max, then returns chain-capped for attempted hop max+1.

expectedReceipts.name: runtime-boundary
expectedReceipts.description: Production scheduleContinuationWorkBatch and scheduleContinuationWork emit below/at/first-over outcomes plus a structured chain-capped receipt.

expectedReceipts.name: durable-state-recovery
expectedReceipts.description: The at-limit chain count is persisted, reloaded from the temporary session store, and still rejects the first recovered over-limit election.

expectedReceipts.name: typed-tool-surface
expectedReceipts.description: The real attempt runner forwards its continuation options into the production continuation tool registry; the registered continue_work executor is invoked three times, schedules only the two in-budget hops, and persists the at-limit count.

expectedReceipts.name: dispatch-boundary-suite
expectedReceipts.description: The production delegate dispatcher is exercised at the selected fixture maximum, proving one at-limit dispatch, first-over rejection before a second spawn, and failed rejected-flow state; the candidate regression suite also passes.

expectedReceipts.name: cleanup
expectedReceipts.description: The disposable worktree/state are removed and no production gateway/config/state/source mutation occurred.

expectedReceipts.name: public-artifact-safety
expectedReceipts.description: Every emitted receipt is checked for private filesystem paths and secret/session/environment/process-output fields before PASS-candidate is written.

expectedReceipts.name: tempo-trace-json
expectedReceipts.description: Public-safe Tempo trace JSON for a continue_work max-chain-length boundary fire. Required for every continuation row (#600). The process-local fixture exports no spans to Tempo, so it cannot discharge this receipt; it stays pending on every fixture run, and only a separately authorized live exact-candidate fire, under its own run, could carry a Tempo trace.

expectedReceipts.name: continuation-trace-correlation
expectedReceipts.description: continuation-trace-correlation.json for the same live fire: one trace matched by reason fingerprint with the accepted in-budget hops and their fire spans. The fixture cannot produce it.

review.notes: This is an exact-candidate process-local typed-tool/runtime claim. It is not an external gateway invocation and is not promoted automatically.

census.limits: The census found accepted continuation entry spans carry no origin, session, turn, or run identity and that proof traffic carries no marker, so this row’s trace receipt joins the continue_work tool span to continuation.work and continuation.work.fire only by shared trace and reason fingerprint. This row’s verdict comes from a process-local exact-candidate fixture that exports no spans to Tempo, so the fixture can never discharge the trace receipts; they record that a continuation-tool PASS without its trace is incomplete.

spans.name: continuation.work
spans.notes: Accepted entry span. Carries no origin/session/turn/run identity.

spans.name: openclaw.tool.execution
spans.notes: Typed continue_work evidence. Joined to the accepted entry only by shared trace.

attributes.notes: Emitted today and asserted by collect-continuation-trace.mjs. It is the strongest join currently available and it is not an identity.
Accepted entry spans carry no signal.kind on the census product basis; origin is contracted by R-OBS-CONT-PROVENANCE.
No k6/Project-81 resource or trace marker exists, so this row’s traffic cannot be separated from organic fleet traffic in a later census.

redaction.rule: The continuation reason is published only as a digest and a length, inside a public-safe Tempo projection. The raw reason, sentinel instructions, raw nonces, raw session keys, and gateway tokens never enter the artifact.

controls.positive: The fixture proves two in-budget elections reach the limit, the first over-limit election is rejected before any spawn, and the at-limit count survives a reload.
controls.negative: A rejected hop that still spawns, or a recovered state that admits the over-limit election, fails the fixture; neither can be argued from a missing trace.

backendUnavailable.notes: The fixture has no telemetry backend at all. The trace receipts stay pending as review debt; they never change the fixture verdict.

verdictAuthority.pass: fixture-result.json reports PASS-candidate: every fixture receipt in liveRunSafety.requiredReceipts except the trace receipts holds. Behavioral only; the trace receipts decide review completeness, not the verdict.
verdictAuthority.partial: Any fixture receipt is missing or unproven.
verdictAuthority.fail: fixture-result.json reports a failure: an over-limit election that is not rejected, a rejected hop that spawns, or a recovered state that admits the over-limit election.

execution.deterministicK6: Not a k6 scenario: run-max-chain-fixture.mjs runs the production boundary in a disposable exact-candidate worktree.
execution.manual: No live fire is authorized for this row, so its trace receipts stay review debt on every fixture run.
execution.relationship: The fixture owns the verdict. The trace receipts decide only whether review is complete.

liveRunSafety.notes: Fail closed for k6/WebSocket: continue_work is internal-only. The supported path is the process-local exact-candidate fixture described in docs/R-CW-6-ISOLATED-MAX-CHAIN.md; review remains mandatory before corpus promotion.
